facts.fact: The World Bank restructuring paper says DIGE carried out data collection for the 2022/23 school year using the new automated data collection and transmission system via the e-SIGE-DRC application, with data dated 9 June 2023 covering the 10 project provinces.

systems.platform: automated data collection and transmission application
systems.owner: DIGE (Direction d'Information de Gestion de l'Education), MEPST
